purpose: Read distinct Multi League competition dimensions for Nexus mapping population
sql: SELECT gw,competition_key,sm_country,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM (SELECT 'GW002' gw,competition_key,sm_country,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW002_IMC Results` UNION SELECT 'GW002',competition_key,sm_country,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW002_IMC Match Report` UNION SELECT 'GW003' gw,competition_key,sm_country,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW003_IMC Results` UNION SELECT 'GW003',competition_key,sm_country,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW003_IMC Match Report` UNION SELECT 'GW007' gw,competition_key,sm_country,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW007_IMC Results` UNION SELECT 'GW007',competition_key,sm_country,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW007_IMC Match Report` UNION SELECT 'GW008' gw,competition_key,sm_country,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW008_IMC Results` UNION SELECT 'GW008',competition_key,sm_country,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW008_IMC Match Report`) x WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'' GROUP BY gw,competition_key,sm_country,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division ORDER BY gw,competition_key
